reason: Technic Panel Fairing Smooth #5 leaks along a slit 0.075 LDU wide and 52 long.
The top face of the lower body (y = -8) ends at x = 6 for z = 34..86: the quads of lines 18 and 20,
the 4-4ndis/3-4ndis of lines 44 and 46 (radius 6) and the 1-4ring2 of s\64683s01.dat line 312.
The strip that face turns up into, line 14 (y = -8.558..-7), stands at x = 6.075, under the edge the
shell's inner surface starts from (lines 76, 82, 91 all use 6.075), and the quad of line 19 meets it
there for z = 86..89. So between z = 34 and 86 nothing spans x = 6..6.075.
The patch adds one quad on the plane y = -8 from x = 5 to 6.5, z = 34..86: it lies on the existing
top face, closes the slit and ends inside the body behind the strip. It adds no volume of its own;
a face exactly 0.075 wide would be narrower than the tolerance the mesh is mended with.
The Power Functions battery box's mounting brackets leak at eight strips 0.08-0.12 LDU wide.
The bracket's outer wall is a radius-9 cylinder drawn with 1-16cyli.dat (lines 120 and 178), which
ends at the 16-gon's vertex x = 3.44415, y = -/+48.31492. The flat face that continues it, lines 43
and 152 (edge lines 45 and 154), starts at x = 3.56, y = -/+48.314: the same corner placed on the true
circle (radius 9.044, 23.2 degrees) instead of on the 16-gon (22.5 degrees). That leaves a strip
0.116 LDU wide down the side and a sliver outside the 2-4ring8 end faces (lines 131 and 189).
The patch moves the two faces' outer corners onto the vertex the cylinder ends at; the subpart is
placed four times (s\919s02.dat lines 11-12, each with both brackets), which is the eight strips.
